fieldValues.title: Objectives address clusters; cluster affirm kept; epics stay plain; walk and remedies
fieldValues.decision_question: What do features address, what is affirmed about a cluster, how are the epics run, and how is a domain walked?
fieldValues.context: Relayed from the owner's local planning session on 2026-10-11 (clerk#32), walked one decision at a time; awaiting the owner's ratification in a clerk session.
fieldValues.alternatives_considered: 7.1 addresses to a cluster, or to a domain (too large). 7.2 drop cluster affirm (#548), or keep it. 7.3 charter a working group now, or keep plain owner-run epics. 7.4 walk by agents suggesting remedies, with a new epic or existing ones.
fieldValues.decision_statement: 7.1 addresses stays an objective to cluster edge. Clusters are named meaning, like post-its: problems are brainstorm ideas, grouped into clusters, and clusters are named by a synthesiser job. Features address clusters. A domain is too large. 7.2 srs-web #548 keeps cluster affirm: a cluster's name and description are affirmed meaning; which problems sit under it (the outline) is fluid arrangement, handled by steward boundary review. 7.3 #28 and #29 stay plain owner-run epics; a working group is chartered on a trigger (a steady ready queue needing delegated merges). 7.4 Walk: agents suggest 1-3 remedies per domain (each answers affirmed problems, with a falsifier and return_when) and the owner affirms. #29 (abfa5866) implements the writing remedy and #28 (5746dee3) the memory remedy; 6b0d881d is reviewed in the writing walk. A new epic only if none fits. The synthesiser job groups and names clusters.
fieldValues.rationale: Meaning is what we affirm; arrangement stays fluid. A working group before there is a queue would be overhead.
fieldValues.revisit_when: Working group: when there is a steady ready queue needing delegated merges.
